sources.title: OpenStreetMap: site and surrounding features
sources.note: ODbL. Site and building footprints, mapped monuments and facilities. No OSM edit dates are interpreted as construction dates.

sources.title: Independent facility reference
sources.note: Official facilities description supports sports grounds and mapped museum/skate/tennis facilities. Museo forecourt, mapped monuments and national flagpole are retained. Pool outline/dimensions not established by OSM or independent imagery: omit the proposed rim. Existing OSM trees are not duplicated. All added positions, counts, widths and heights are schematic estimates fitted to OSM, not surveyed geometry. This note covers the initial facility details authored from OSM and the cited independent reference; later owner-reference or landcover work is described in its own source notes. No timeline dates are inferred.
